import collections

def solve_orbit(start_value, target_set):
    # Define the generating transformations
    def T1(r): return -r        # Negation
    def T2(r): return 1 - r    # Complementation
    def T3(r): return 1 / r    # Reciprocal

    # Use a set to track visited states (the orbit)
    orbit = {start_value}
    queue = collections.deque([start_value])
    
    # Convert target set elements to Fractions for comparison
    targets = {Fraction(r) for r in target_set}

                queue.append(r_prime)
                
    return found_targets
